item.title: This Rapper Bought Jelly Roll a Truck When He Was Struggling Financially: ‘That’s My Dog’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to this week's music update. You might know Jelly Roll as a country star, but did you know he had a humble beginning? His friend and fellow musician Yelawolf recently shared a story about how he helped Jelly Roll out when he was struggling financially.
[Short music transition]
Host: According to Yelawolf, Jelly Roll was in a tough spot, driving an old cop car with no license plate and no license. But Yelawolf took him under his wing, taking him on tour and even giving him a brand new Chevrolet Silverado so he could provide for his family during Christmas.
[Short music transition]
Host: Jelly Roll has been open about his past struggles, including time in prison and substance abuse issues. But with the support of his loved ones, including his wife Bunnie Xo and their children, he's built a successful music career, winning three Grammys and one CMA Award. His latest album, Beautifully Broken, even topped the Billboard 200.
[Short music transition]
Host: Despite recently filing for divorce, Jelly Roll and Bunnie Xo are still on good terms and are even planning to welcome a new baby together through IVF. As Jelly Roll said, "Me and my wife are best friends... Bunnie, I love you, baby. Thank you for those 10 years."
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today's update. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one.
